events.name: Philadelphia Union at New England Revolution

headlines.description: Peyton Miller became the fifth-youngest player to score a goal in the MLS playoffs as New England beat Philadelphia 2-0 to open a best-of-three first-round series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teenager Miller leads Revs to win over Union in Game 1

events.name: Columbus Crew at Inter Miami CF

headlines.description: - Gonzalo Tapia scored twice, Patrick Schulte made five saves and the seventh-seeded Columbus Crew upset Lionel Messi and defending MLS Cup champion Inter Miami 3-0 on Saturday in Game 1 of their best-of-three, first-round playoff series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Columbus downs Messi and Miami in Game 1 of best-of-3 playoff series
